name: regexpatho
algorithm: (a|aa)*c, exponential for a backtracking engine, found in n bytes of 'a' (no match) and in the same bytes ending in 'c' (one match of the whole text), rounds times (README.md).

skip.c: no std regex in C (POSIX regex.h is not ISO C, and the MSVC CRT has none)
skip.rust: no std regex in Rust (the regex crate is not std; no crate stands in)
skip.mk-wrap: the only arithmetic is the checksum, far below 2^62

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries; the checksum (n plus the match's length per round, and nothing from the failed search) checks that both found the same match
notes: Both engines are linear in the input. Mk: forward DFA, then the reverse DFA from the end for the start; Go: its NFA simulation (the input is too long for its bounded backtracker).
